row.body: The food bundle is tied to a route note for new arrivals; the last line says the group left before the next watch could bring the promised supplies.
row.title: A place at the table

cites.quote: survivors welcome to join us - always

sidecar.gloss: A group left before the next scheduled supply handoff.
sidecar.rival_reading: A work crew could have left a meal bundle at a field stop; the timing does not establish why they departed.
